newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Pekaes Auto plans to issue PLN 50 mln CP.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Pekaes Auto plans to issue PLN 50 mln CP.

text.p: Poland's Pekaes Auto-Transport SA may issue up to 50 million zlotys of commercial paper, the issue's manager and dealer Bank Handlowy SA told Reuters on Tuesday.

Under an agreement signed on October 31, 1996, Pekaes may raise up to 50 million zlotys in terms of outstanding debt with maturities from seven to 364 days depending on the firm's current funding needs.
Handlowy's brokerage will offer to sell the CP with a discount at the tenders to a closed group of investors starting from this month. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
